value.cycle_on_page: winter activities and march break camp
value.evidence: Early registration for winter activities and march break camp begins on Tuesday, December 1, at 7 a.m. for eligible residents of all ages.
value.eligibility_evidence: The page labels this opening for residents: "for eligible residents of all ages". It gives no separate general or non-resident date; residents not eligible "will register on the general registration dates", which are not printed.
value.note: The page prints "Tuesday, December 1, at 7 a.m." for winter activities but never states a year for the winter cycle, so the date and time are left null. The only year on the page is the "Date modified: November 10, 2026" stamp, which is not cycle evidence. This is an early local registration for eligible residents at free centres, and the general registration dates are not published on this page.
